question: In the Global Innovation Index, 2025, India ranked first among which group of economies?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lower-middle income economies**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to the **Global Innovation Index (GII) 2025**, **India** continues to be a global leader in innovation among **lower-middle income economies**, securing the **1st rank** within this specific income group.
 
• The index is published annually by the **World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO)**, a specialized agency of the **United Nations** based in **Geneva**, **Switzerland**.
 
• In addition to its income group leadership, **India** also holds the **top position** in the **Central and Southern Asia** region, a rank it has maintained for several consecutive years.
 
• The **GII 2025** report highlights that **India** is one of the few emerging economies that consistently performs above expectations relative to its **level of economic development**. *Hence, the statement regarding its rank in the lower-middle income group is correct.*
